يصطلقن (form VIII)
# يَصْطَلِقْنَ (yaṣṭaliqna) /jasˤ.tˤa.liq.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
# يُصْطَلَقْنَ (yuṣṭalaqna) /jusˤ.tˤa.laq.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
